subject: world_language
concept: Writing a formal letter or email appropriate to a professional or academic context in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR B2 'write formal correspondence' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches formal letter/email conventions (greeting, closing, register) to the correct target-language forms
exercise.abstract: Student writes a formal letter or email using appropriate conventions and register in the target language

assessment.mastery_threshold: letter/email uses appropriate formal conventions and register throughout
misconception_flags: mixes informal and formal register within the same formal piece

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
